chunks: Alas the woe that day for those who deny!

key_terms.لِلْمُکَذِّبِينَ: For the deniers, those who reject the truth
key_terms.وَيْلٌ: Woe or calamity, a specific type of punishment in Hell
key_terms.يَوْمَئِذٍ: That day, referring to the Day of Judgment

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Wail' for the deniers in Surah Al-Mursalat?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'Wail' is often interpreted as a specific type of lamentation or cry of regret that precedes the actual punishment, emphasizing the psychological torment of the deniers. This verse underscores the finality of divine retribution for those who persist in rejecting the Prophets and the Imams, linking their denial to the broader theme of accountability on the Day of Resurrection.
